correctness.rationale: For each \(n\ge3\) the independent insertion-rank representation gives \(D_n\) as a sum of record-low Bernoulli indicators and gives local rank inequalities for \(B_i\). On any interior leaf event, the affected three-rank sum has exact conditional upper tails 3/(i+1),3/[i(i+1)],0 versus unconditional 3/(i+1),(3i-2)/[i(i-1)(i+1)],1/[(i-1)i(i+1)]. Strict stochastic ordering follows by convolution with independent unaffected ranks. Boundary cases are checked separately and yield exact local covariance and telescoped aggregate. The checker enumerates every insertion permutation \(3\le n\le8\) and validates rational triple counts; the proof, not the enumeration, establishes all n.
